2024 Q3.gq: On a reported basis, at current spot rates, our increased outlook reflects the expectation to reach at least CHF2.29 billion in net sales for the full year 2024.

2025 Q4.bq: Wholesale also delivered exceptional results, outperforming our expectations, driven by strong sell-through numbers and sustained demand from key accounts in the Americas and EMEA.
